verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.convex.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200), which also points agents to a site-level llms.txt. The homepage tells users to make their agent a Convex expert via an agent-setup.md file, and the docs state that Convex works well with coding agents. Missing for 10: per-page markdown versions of the docs (the home.md probe returned 404).
